ranked.headline: Frozen protein-model embeddings rank enzymes, substrates and mutants under harder tests
ranked.summary: Kinetics, EC assignment, stability and binding-site predictors now sit on frozen PLM/structure encoders, paired with campaign-grouped benchmarks and wet-lab checks.

ranked.headline: Evaluation design and decomposed metrics reshape what cofolding and binding predictors claim
ranked.summary: New benchmarks separate ligand placement from protein conformation, add apo/holo cross-state splits, and test pose ranking agents, redefining reported accuracy.

ranked.headline: Generative models predict perturbation responses and reconstruct single-cell dynamics
ranked.summary: Flow matching, disentangled VAEs and optimal transport are being used to predict unseen perturbations and recover dynamics from static single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Donor-aware single-cell models localize disease effects to cells, genes and programs
ranked.summary: Several new methods treat donors as the unit of inference in case-control single-cell and spatial cohorts, prioritizing interpretable disease attribution.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and spatial partitions gain explicit null models and significance tests
ranked.summary: SigDoTS and ProClust add formal significance tests to spatial domains and scRNA-seq groupings, while PRISM and stochprofIC model contamination and noise directly.

ranked.headline: Sequence models and count-based eQTL methods are tested for individual-level expression effects
ranked.summary: New sc-eQTL count models, uncertainty-aware prediction and stress tests of sequence models bear on how variant effects are inferred across individuals and cell types.

ranked.headline: Learned models and curated workflows extract functional and adaptive signal from microbial genomes
ranked.summary: New work pairs protein language models, matrix factorization, and standardized pipelines to mine resistance, virulence, and prophage content from microbial genomes.

ranked.headline: Curated structural datasets and modular pipelines extend protein-ligand modeling
ranked.summary: New curated complex sets, pocket-based target selection and open pipelines address input quality and diversity for structure-based ligand modeling.

ranked.headline: Association inference is paired with bias correction, pooled re-analysis and cross-species resource building
ranked.summary: New preprints pair selection-bias correction, survival pseudo-observations and uniform meta-analysis with cross-species genetic resources for interpreting association signals.

ranked.headline: Generative and physics-based methods replace single structures with conformational ensembles and energetics
ranked.summary: Generative ensemble models for proteins, antibodies, IDPs and RNA now sit beside MD-based pocket and strain analyses that treat structure as dynamic and state-dependent.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test whether perturbation and drug-response predictions hold across sources and priors
ranked.summary: New benchmarks expose limited cross-source concordance and prior-dependent predictability, reframing how perturbation and drug-response models should be evaluated.

ranked.headline: Curated structure and disorder databases add structural context and machine-actionable access
ranked.summary: Four NAR database updates expand structure-linked annotation and programmatic access, spanning CATH/TED domains, MobiDB disorder, and curated mutation data.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based ML and MS tools for RNA therapeutics, from siRNA design to tRNA and oligo analysis
ranked.summary: New RNA tools span siRNA activity, translation efficiency, tRNA nanopore classification and oligo MS, pointing to maturing design and measurement for RNA therapeutics.

ranked.headline: Design models for guides, primers and proteins are audited for what scores can certify
ranked.summary: New preprints test what confidence and ranking scores support in CRISPR, siRNA and protein design, exposing benchmark leakage, cohort limits and steering failures.

ranked.headline: Biomedical ML pairs explicit, checkable generalization claims with models built for distribution shift
ranked.summary: New work treats cold-start and cross-site generalization as auditable targets, pairing leakage-aware evaluation with shift-oriented models in drug and neuroimaging ML.

ranked.headline: Isoform-level and 3' end resolution is being built into single-cell, spatial and long-read resources
ranked.summary: New tools and atlases resolve polyadenylation and transcript usage across single-cell, spatial and long-read data, extending to proteomic and aging contexts.

ranked.headline: Reimplemented and consolidated pipelines speed up sequencing analysis and public-data reuse
ranked.summary: New tools rewrite or wrap analysis steps, from deepTools4 to CLIPittyClip, and harmonize public metadata to make large-scale reanalysis more tractable.

ranked.headline: Predicted structures are being judged against membrane geometry, ensembles and local energetics
ranked.summary: New work tests AlphaFold outputs against bilayer geometry and amyloid polymorphism, while a GPU frustratometer makes proteome-scale energetic analysis feasible.

ranked.headline: Methods bridge sparse cancer measurements with external references or complementary modalities
ranked.summary: Seven preprints pair cfDNA, scRNA-seq, histology and molecular data with external references to improve cancer detection, survival and clone inference.

ranked.headline: Analysis and split choices, not just models, determine apparent performance in biological modelling
ranked.summary: Three preprints show that centring, recentering and trial-level splits can change or inflate conclusions about neural and biomechanical model performance.

ranked.headline: Graph models couple network topology with pairwise and multi-view relations in biology
ranked.summary: Recent work applies graph neural and hypergraph models to gene regulatory, drug response, and host-virus interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Curated resources map circular RNA translation, RBP target sites and snoRNA annotation across species
ranked.summary: Recent multi-species resources extend circRNA translation evidence and RBP and snoRNA target maps across model organisms.

ranked.headline: LLM pipelines extract structured chemical-effect evidence from biomedical literature
ranked.summary: Corpus-scale LLM mining now yields continuously updated knowledge bases, with human review retained in hybrid AOP and curation designs.

ranked.headline: Read-level and sketch-based methods reduce compute cost in viral sequence inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool report speedups from 2.1-6.6x up to ~40,000-fold by working directly on reads, seeds, or sketches.

ranked.headline: Curated peptide databases and ADMET models for therapeutic property prediction
ranked.summary: Peptide therapeutics are expanding, and permeability, stability, and inconsistent evaluation practices now constrain how predictive models are compared.

ranked.headline: Single-cell multiomics map regulatory and cell-type organization of basal ganglia
ranked.summary: Joint chromatin and transcriptome profiling at single-cell resolution now extends to human and primate basal ganglia, with population-level variation.

ranked.headline: Long-read methylation mapping paired with transposable element and SV genotyping
ranked.summary: Long-read data now supports sample-specific CpG methylation calls and polymorphic transposable element annotation within unified analysis pipelines.

ranked.headline: Lettuce isoform atlas and PlantPAN 5.0 extend plant regulatory annotation to isoforms
ranked.summary: Population-scale isoform atlases and integrated multiomics regulatory databases now link plant transcript variation to trait and network evidence.

ranked.headline: Spatial omics models link histology and gene relationships to expression
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell datasets now support gene-wise and neighborhood-level inference with explicit units of quantification.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes accelerate k-mer lookup and pangenome exact matching
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report batch-updatable colored indexes, faster and smaller k-mer dictionaries, and compressed-space matching across pangenome assemblies.

ranked.headline: Proteomics search spaces widen to proteoforms, modifications, and coverage gaps
ranked.summary: Expanded search spaces now reach dark-proteome spectra and proteoforms, while peptide coverage bias in public data is measured explicitly.

ranked.headline: Generative models are judged on downstream criteria beyond docking-style scores
ranked.summary: Constraint-aware generators for 3D molecules and conjugates now appear alongside PBPK-based exposure re-scoring of generated PARP1 candidates.

ranked.headline: Polymer models link chromatin structure, dynamics and looping mechanisms
ranked.summary: Polymer simulations now infer chromatin dynamics from static Hi-C data and test how well microscopy constrains looping estimates.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links shark epigenomics, telomeric introns and Wnt gene evolution
ranked.summary: Recent comparisons across shark, eukaryotic, and vertebrate genomes address intron origins, methylation, and gene family dynamics.

ranked.headline: Resources place methylation, GWAS, single-cell and omics evidence at finer resolution
ranked.summary: Expanded resources now map cancer biomarkers, GWAS loci and gene-phenotype evidence onto CpG sites, cell types and individual cell lines.

ranked.headline: Coding content inferred from cross-species alignment and orthology, not one reference
ranked.summary: Cross-species alignments and orthology now recover coding sequences and protein family content beyond per-genome reference annotation.

ranked.headline: Computational antibody and binder design diagnosed beyond raw structure predictions
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs agentic, language-model and structure-based design with diagnostic checks of binding, specificity and self-association.

ranked.headline: Biologically grounded models forecast, explain, and test neural population dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether input realism, hierarchical memory, and recurrent feedback in computational models match neural and behavioral measurements.

ranked.headline: Deep learning methods denoise and classify cryo-EM and cryo-ET data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply unsupervised autoencoders and diffusion models to cryo-EM/ET particle classification and tilt-series denoising.

ranked.headline: Hybrid and simulation-trained models forecast epidemic and lineage growth
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication test forecasting methods on out-of-sample COVID-19 data and multi-variable outbreak horizons.
